duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā wajʿalnā muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatinā ummatam muslimatan laka wa arinā manāsikanā wa tub ʿalaynā innaka Antat-Tawwābur-Raḥīm.
duas.translation: Our Lord! make of us Muslims, bowing to Thy (Will), and of our progeny a people Muslim, bowing to Thy (will); and show us our place for the celebration of (due) rites; and turn unto us (in Mercy); for Thou art the Oft-Returning, Most Merciful.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij 'alnī muqīmaṣ-ṣalāti wa min dhurriyyatī Rabbanā wa taqabbal du'ā'. Rabbanagh-fir lī wa liwālidayya wa lilmu'minīna Yawma yaqūmul-ḥisāb.
duas.translation: O my Lord! make me one who establishes regular Prayer, and also (raise such) among my offspring O our Lord! and accept Thou my Prayer. O our Lord! cover (us) with Thy Forgiveness - me, my parents, and (all) Believers, on the Day that the Reckoning will be established!

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā hablānā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyuninw-wa ajʿalnā lilmuttaqīna imāmā.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī mil-ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibah, innaka Samīʿuḍ-ḍuʿā'.
duas.translation: O my Lord! Grant unto me from Thee a progeny that is pure: for Thou art He that heareth prayer!

duas.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi lā tadhar-nī fardanw-wa Anta Khayrul-Wārithīn.
duas.translation: O my Lord! leave me not without offspring, though thou art the best of inheritors.
O my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)!
